# Drop Coverage

> Drop Coverage publishes NBA player predictions for every game, set against the bookmaker lines, with a public record of what covered.

Drop Coverage (thedropcoverage.com) projects every NBA player and game each night: a prediction for points, rebounds, assists, threes and the combined markets, with the range the result lands inside 80% of the time, set against the bookmakers' player prop lines in decimal odds. Game trends give every team's record against the spread and over/under by situation and date range, and each team's game log. Times are Australian eastern time (AEDT/AEST). The Drop is one player prop each night: 65%+ to cover and 8+ points above the bookmakers' fair chance, with our chance weighed 70/30 against the market's, and of those that qualify the one with the most expected value, chosen by the model, never by a person, staked at 1 unit and graded on closing-line value. Accuracy is published openly: average error by market and how often results land inside the ranges.

Key terms: "edge" is our probability minus the bookmaker's probability with its margin removed. "CLV" (closing-line value) is how far the market moved our way after we posted: the bookmaker's chance of our side at tip-off minus its chance when we posted, both with its margin removed, in percentage points. COVERED / NOT COVERED is used only for graded results (The Drop and the graded props), never for every projection; every projection's accuracy is published separately. Projections are data, not a promise of profit. 18+. Gamble responsibly: Gambling Help Online, 1800 858 858 (Australia); 21+, 1-800-GAMBLER (US).

## Pages

- [NBA predictions today](https://thedropcoverage.com/predictions): every player tonight, the bookmaker line and how often he has cleared it in his last five and ten games; members see the prediction, probability and edge
- [The Drop](https://thedropcoverage.com/tip): the player prop we rate most likely to cover tonight, on the record, with every Drop since, its closing-line value and its units
- [NBA game trends](https://thedropcoverage.com/games): against the spread and over/under by situation and date range, with tonight's games and the bookmaker lines
- [NBA tips today](https://thedropcoverage.com/nba/tips-today/): today's games with the bookmaker lines and The Drop, linking each game's page
- [Game pages](https://thedropcoverage.com/nba/games/): one page per game, dated, with the win chance, injuries, rest, form, trends and the key players' last five games; the result is added after the game
- [Team pages](https://thedropcoverage.com/teams/): each team's game log with the line, cover, total and over/under, and with or without any player
- [Player props and stats](https://thedropcoverage.com/players/): every player's predictions, season averages and recent games
- [With & Without](https://thedropcoverage.com/with-without): any player's numbers with or without any teammate, over the season or his last N games, game by game against a line
- [Matchups](https://thedropcoverage.com/matchups): how each defence changes what players produce by position and stat, with pace
- [How it works](https://thedropcoverage.com/learn/): how the predictions are made, how to read the board, what the ranges mean and how The Drop is graded
- [Track record](https://thedropcoverage.com/track-record): how accurate the predictions are
- [NBA hit rates](https://thedropcoverage.com/nba/hit-rates/): players who cleared a line in 9 or 10 of their last 10 games, with the best Australian price and our prediction
- [NBA player prop rules at Australian bookmakers](https://thedropcoverage.com/learn/nba-player-prop-rules-by-bookmaker): what happens to a prop at Sportsbet, TAB, bet365 and Neds/Ladbrokes when a player is ruled out, injured or ejected, overtime, void legs in a same game multi, and which stats settle the bet
- [NBA player prop rules at US sportsbooks](https://thedropcoverage.com/learn/nba-player-prop-rules-us-sportsbooks): the same for DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, Fanatics and theScore Bet, including same game parlays, early-injury promotions and stat corrections
- [How Drop Coverage compares](https://thedropcoverage.com/learn/how-drop-coverage-compares): the four kinds of NBA betting site, what Drop Coverage does differently and where it is weaker, and eight questions to ask of any prediction service
- [NBA games today in Australian time](https://thedropcoverage.com/schedule)
